<MethodEndpoint

get_table_data/ retrieves one of six fully populated tables based on the year timeframe provided. The return is a downloadable CSV file. The data will contain the origin, destination, commodity type, transportation type, distance traveled, tonnage, and value based on the timeframe provided.


<Heading
  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
  children={"Request"}
>
</Heading>

<ParamsDetails
  parameters={[{"in":"query","name":"table","schema":{"type":"string"},"description":"The tables follow the naming convention of \"faf\" or \"state\" followed by 0, 1, 2, or 3, which describe the meaning of each table. FAF tables use regions, while state tables use U.S. states.\n\n* 0 indicates that the table includes all movements of commodities between states, including those entering or leaving the U.S.\n\n* 1 means the commodities are transported only within the U.S.\n\n* 2 shows imported commodities into the U.S.\n\n* 3 shows exported commodities from the U.S.\n\nHence the options for table are: faf0, faf1, faf2, faf3, state0, state1, state2, state3\n"},{"in":"query","name":"timeframe","schema":{"type":"string"},"description":"The variable timeframe takes a list that can hold either one or two integer values for years, like the following [2017] or [2017,2025]. One year will give all the data stored for that year, while two years will give the value for those two years as well as each year in between the two.\n"}]}
>
  
</ParamsDetails>
